newsitem.title: USA: Kohl's to open about 30 stores in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Kohl's to open about 30 stores in 1997.

text.p: Kohl's Corp., which operates department stores in 16 states, said Tuesday it plans to open about 30 stores in 1997.

On Friday, the company will open nine outlets, including eight in the Washington/Baltimore market and one in Evansville, Ind. In April, nine new stores will open in the Philadelphia area. Kohl's also said it will enter the Pittsburgh market during the third quarter.
To support these markets, Kohl's will open a distribution centre in Winchester, Va., during this summer.
As of Feb. 1, Kohl's had 150 family-oriented speciality department stores, compared with 128 a year ago.

Kohl's also said its profits rose to almost $52 million, or 70 cents a share, in the quarter ended Feb. 1 from $42.1 million, or 57 cents a share, in the year-ago period. Revenues for the Menomonee Falls, Wis.-based company grew to $846.9 million from $707.0 million.
Kohl's stock rose 50 cents to $47 on the New York Stock Exchange.
